title: Generate a brand theme for @fmmenchi/ui
description: Scaffolds a complete [data-theme] preset instantiated from the INSTALLED @fmmenchi/tokens contract (always in sync with your tokens version) and wires the validate-themes target so the theme is gated in CI.

name.description: Theme name — becomes the `data-theme` attribute value.
name.x-prompt: What is the theme name (data-theme value)?

project.description: The project the theme belongs to (gets the validate-themes target).

directory.description: Directory for the theme file, relative to the project root.

skipValidation.description: Do not gate this theme: skips BOTH wiring the validate-themes target and the pre-write check on a --from file. One flag, one meaning — an escape hatch for installing a theme you already know is not finished.

scheme.description: Whether this is a light or a dark theme — emitted as `color-scheme`, so the parts the browser paints (a select's popup, a native checkbox) follow the theme. Without it a dark brand theme ships white native lists on Safari and Firefox.

from.description: Path to a theme file to install (as exported by a theme builder) instead of scaffolding from the reference contract. Only its `declarations` object is read — a flat map of `--fm-*` custom property to value, at whatever layer, so a base and a ramp step are as installable as a role. Every other key the file carries, including whatever the builder keeps to reopen its own form, is ignored. The theme is validated before anything is written.

tokensPath.description: Advanced: explicit path to @fmmenchi/tokens' vars.css (when it cannot be resolved from the workspace root).
